title: Portal lead reply and viewing booking
summary: Every enquiry from the property portals gets a text within a minute, three qualifying questions and a viewing slot on the right agent's calendar.
outcome: First reply down from about 3 hours to 47 seconds

messages.text: Thanks for asking about the 3-bed on Mueller. Moving in the next three months?

title: Missed-call text-back for a lettings team
summary: When a call goes unanswered, the caller gets a WhatsApp message within 30 seconds asking what they need. Viewing requests are booked, repairs are logged for the property manager.
outcome: Missed calls returned by message in 30 seconds

title: Vendor call notes into the CRM
summary: Appraisal calls with sellers are summarised under fixed headings: price expectation, timing, objections and next step. The note lands on the property record before the agent is back in the car.
outcome: Notes on the record 10 minutes after the call

title: WhatsApp and phone receptionist
summary: Calls and WhatsApp messages are answered day and night. Routine visits are booked in the diary, and anything about pain goes straight to a person.
outcome: Missed calls down from 41 a week to 3

messages.text: Can I move my check-up on Thursday?

title: Patient recall reminders
summary: Patients who have not rebooked after a course of treatment get a message offering three times. A one-word reply books the visit, and the clinic owner sees the week's rebookings in one list.
outcome: 27 follow-up visits booked in the first month

title: Website assistant for treatment questions and bookings
summary: A chat assistant on the clinic's website answers questions about treatments, prices and aftercare from the clinic's own approved wording, in English and Arabic, then offers a consultation slot.
outcome: 6 in 10 website questions answered without staff

messages.text: How long is a first consultation?
About 30 minutes. Would you like Tuesday or Thursday?

title: Sales call notes and follow-ups
summary: After each customer call the notes are written, the deal is updated in the CRM and a follow-up email is drafted for the rep to read and send.
outcome: Follow-up draft ready 12 minutes after the call

title: Monthly client reports assembled automatically
summary: Numbers from the ad platforms and analytics are pulled on the first of the month, dropped into each client's report template and given a plain-English summary for the account manager to edit.
outcome: Report prep down from 2 days to half a day

title: Audit of a candidate enquiry process
summary: A two-week review of how candidate and client enquiries are handled. The agency received a costed list of five possible automations, ranked by hours saved, with two marked as not worth doing yet.

title: Invoice to bank line matching
summary: Supplier invoices are read and matched to bank lines automatically. Bookkeepers work only from a queue of exceptions, each with the reason shown.
outcome: 82% of invoices matched without a person

title: Client document chaser
summary: An assistant messages each client once a week with the payments that still have no receipt. Clients reply with a photo, and it is filed against the right transaction.
outcome: Missing receipts at month-end down by two thirds

title: Receipt capture from email to accounts
summary: Receipts forwarded to one email address are read, coded to an expense category and posted as drafts in the accounting software, ready for a weekly review.
outcome: About 6 hours of keying saved each month
